Adam Smith provided Li Hua with the contact information for the maintenance worker who could assist with repairing a broken streetlight. The phone number given for the maintenance worker is **314159**. This detail is mentioned in the conversation where Adam Smith reassures Li Hua that she can reach out to the maintenance worker to facilitate the fixing of the streetlight issue.

> AdamSmith: You can call the maintenance worker at 314159. They'll be able to help with that.
